description: CDS table-tennis section (middle of the low block): one-storey red brick, plain west wall with six small square vents next to the hall, then five open pointed arches; the southernmost is the entrance bay facing DoorCdsMainEntry (world y -200). Dark bitumen roof, brick parapet, light coping. From Docs/map-reference/area1/cds-building.png; dimensions estimated. Footprint = the blockout (x 1480..2000, y -450..0 world px). Two north-south slices; the north slice's roof runs 0.06 m under the canteen.
